SPICE requires agents to maintain their contextual state within a structured, dense information framework that is scalable and interpretable, facilitating inspection by users or integration with downstream system components. SPICE accomplishes this by formulating updates as Formal Semantic Parsing, with the formal language defining the allowable solution space of the constructed context.
